answer.book: Analysis logica of Cicero's Laelius, sive de amicitia dialogus, a Ramist-method analysis by Marcus Beumler (Speyer, 1583): front matter of dedication, preface and poems, then Cicero's dialogue with Beumler's analysis of it, running on in one unnumbered text.
